chunks.arabic_text: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى، عَنْ حَمَّادَ بْنِ عِيسَى، عَنْ حَرِيزٍ، عَنْ زُرَارَةَ وَمُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ وَبُرَيْدٍ الْعَجَلِيِّ قَالُوا: قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ لِحُمْرَانَ بْنِ أَعْيَنٍ فِي شَيْءٍ سَأَلَهُ: إِنَّمَا يَهْلِكُ النَّاسُ لِأَنَّهُمْ لَا يَسْأَلُونَ

translations.en: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Hariz, from Zurara and Muhammad ibn Muslim and Burayd al-Ijli, they said: Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said to Humran ibn A'yan regarding a matter he had asked him about: The people are destroyed because they do not ask.

en.summary: Imam Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) states that the destruction of people stems from their failure to ask questions. This hadith emphasizes the importance of inquiry and seeking knowledge as a means of guidance and avoiding error.
en.seo_question: Why do people get destroyed according to Imam al-Sadiq?
